shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat rectangular stone face
register or band divisions across the surface
repeated row of similar motifs along the top
schematic rendering with raised outlines against a flat ground
justification: Both show low-relief motifs organised into horizontal registers on a flat slab, with a row of repeated similar elements along the top edge, which gives a loose compositional echo. But the content differs entirely: A is a dense grid of block-like abstract sign cartouches with rounded internal detail, while B depicts recognisable creatures in profile (quadrupeds, a large bird with splayed wings, a long-necked bird) arranged freely within bands, so no specific motif is shared.
